response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as count_per_type FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(count_per_type) as avg_count FROM type_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT tc.count_per_type, tc.count_per_type - ac.avg_count as excess FROM type_counts tc CROSS JOIN avg_count ac WHERE tc.count_per_type > ac.avg_count) SELECT AVG(count_per_type) as average_of_counts, AVG(excess) as average_excess FROM above_avg
